dedupe_keys.name: microzonazione sismica carta delle microzone omogenee in prospettiva sismica mops

description: Microzonazione Sismica - Carta delle Microzone Omogenee in Prospettiva Sismica (MOPS) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by centromicrozonazionesismica.eu. The MS study is summarized in the Map of Homogeneous Microzones in Seismic Perspective (MOPS Map), with which stable zones are identified and characterized, stable zones susceptible to local amplification and areas subject to instability, such as landslides, surface breaks due to faults and dynamic liquefaction of the soil. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "Seismic Microzonation - Map of Homogeneous Microzones in Seismic Perspective (MOPS)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include RNDT, opendata, Microzonazione Sismica, normativa regionale. The listing shows 5 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
